sloka: समुद्रस्य ततः क्रुद्धो रामो रक्त अन्त लोचनः ।समीपस्थम् उवाच इदम् लक्ष्मणम् शुभ लक्ष्मणम् ॥६-२१-१३॥।।
transliteration: samudrasya tataḥ kruddho rāmo rakta anta locanaḥ ।samīpastham uvāca idam lakṣmaṇam śubha lakṣmaṇam ॥6-21-13॥।।

translations.english: Enraged at the ocean, Rama's eyes turned red. He went near Lakshmana who was endowed with auspicious marks and thus addressed.
